question: Corneas stored in McCarey-Kaufman (M-K) medium at 4°C can be stored for up to 4 days (96 hours) before transplantation.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is TRUE. M-K medium at 4°C = up to 96 hours (4 days). For longer storage (up to 4 weeks), organ culture media like Optisol-GS at 37°C are used. Moist chamber is only 48 hours.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. M-K medium (a modified tissue culture medium with dextran) stores corneas at 4°C for up to 96 hours (4 days). Compare: moist chamber = 48 h; organ culture (Optisol, Cornisol) = up to 28 days at 37°C.
